earlier_sources: https://github.com/googlefonts/googlefontdirectory-hg at 52f780bc9d197280a9f430574e179a5f233c56b6, ofl/portersansblock/: the font as built and its metadata; src/ holds PorterSansBlock-Regular.otf (a CFF build of the font; the release is TrueType) and METADATA_comments.txt, no source.
disclose: The release kerns through a GPOS kern feature and also carries a legacy `kern` table (2209 pairs). Shapers read the GPOS feature, which these sources keep; the legacy table, read only by software without GPOS support, is not carried.

The released font is hinted (TrueType instructions). These sources carry no TrueType instructions, so the build is hinted by ttfautohint: the outlines, spacing and layout are the release's, its rendering at small sizes under a TrueType interpreter is not. Hinting is not compared by the gates.
